page.overview:
Who is Elidibus?

Elidibus, also known as Elidibs, is a legendary wizard from Final Fantasy Tactics said to be a hero of the Fifty Years' War. He is hidden on the lowest level of the Midlight's Deep. How he came to possess the Serpentarius, the secret thirteenth auracite, is unclear, but he can transform into a Lucavi demon of the same name.

Elidibus hails from the Magick City of Gariland, where he presumably trained as a wizard. Later, during the Fifty Years' War, Elidibus distinguished himself with his magickal talent while fighting the invading armies of the kingdom of Romanda, using numerous black magicks and summoning spells he discovered in ancient tomes to turn the tide of war in favor of Ivalice. He disappeared without a trace once Riovanes Castle was regained and was never seen again. Overall, it is likely that, due to his efforts during the war, Elidibus was considered a hero by the Ivalicians.

It is uncertain how Elidibus obtained the Serpentarius Stone and ended up being possessed by it. Similarly, it is unknown how he ended up in Midlight's Deep, however, it is known that Elidibus remained secluded in the depths of the place for years until he was found by Ramza Beoulve and his allies during the climax of the War of the Lions. Presuming they wanted his auracite, the wizard transformed into a Lucavi and together with some reavers attacked them. After a fierce fight, Serpentarius was killed, also killing Elidibus in the process, and leaving the Serpentarius Stone behind.

Elidibus is a veteran mage with pale skin, pale brown hair, brown eyes, and a white beard. He wears a brown wizard hat identical to the black mage's, a black robe with purplish blue cloak and yellow linings with two golden chains at the center of his cloak, similar to the summoners, and black boots. Elidibus carries the Serpentarius auracite beneath his cloak.
